topic.source_contract: Agricultural Land Classification, predictive mapping and BMV evidence

facts.guard: predictive mapping is not a detailed site survey

facts.purpose: assess development proposals and protect BMV land
facts.guard: guidance is not a planning outcome
grade requires evidence appropriate to the proposal
screening is not site-specific development refusal

facts.planning: soil and agricultural land quality are material considerations

scope_guards: Predictive ALC is strategic-scale evidence and not a detailed field survey.
Grades 1, 2 and 3a are BMV; grade 3 must not be treated as wholly BMV without subdivision evidence.
Soil, climate and site limitations must be considered together.
Map boundaries are not HMLR title or development red-lines.
BMV designation is a planning consideration and not an automatic refusal.
Agricultural capability is not crop yield, land value or development viability for a candidate.
Absence of detailed survey data is not proof of low-grade land.
No score or promotion is written without current mapping, detailed ALC evidence, site geometry and planning context.
